title: Gearbox assembly cell: station overview
text: Station 14 of the car factory twin assembles the six-speed gearbox: housing press, shaft insertion, synchro ring fit, end-cover torque. Cycle time 58 s, two operators, one robot.

title: Gearbox end-of-line test
text: Every gearbox runs a 90 s end-of-line test: shift through all gears at 1500 rpm, noise and vibration check, leak test at 0.5 bar. A failed unit goes to the rework bay.

title: Gearbox torque spec, end cover bolts (engineer)
text: End cover M8 bolts: 24 Nm plus 45 degrees, sequence 1-5-3-7-2-6-4-8. Tool DC nutrunner channel 3. A unit outside 22-27 Nm is blocked at station 15. Internal spec rev F.

title: Gearbox synchro ring supplier deviation 2026-11 (engineer)
text: Batch SR-4471 of 3rd/4th synchro rings measured 0.04 mm over the drawing on inner cone. Concession granted for 600 units, 100 % noise test, follow-up at week 48.

title: Paint shop: base coat booth
text: Two robots per side, electrostatic bells, 22 C and 65 % humidity. Booth changeover between colours takes 9 s.

title: Body shop: spot welding line
text: 312 spot welds per body-in-white, 18 robots, adaptive current control. Weld quality sampled by ultrasonic check every 50th body.

title: Gearbox line downtime root cause, week 45 (engineer)
text: Shaft insertion press stopped 3 times: proximity sensor bracket loosened by vibration. Fix: thread lock and a second bracket. Downtime 47 min total.

title: Final assembly: drivetrain marriage
text: The drivetrain (engine plus gearbox) is lifted into the body on an AGV. Eight bolts, torque-monitored, 72 s takt.

title: Gearbox oil fill and level check
text: Station 16 fills 1.9 l of gear oil by mass flow meter and checks the level by camera. Overfill is drained automatically.

title: Gearbox cost breakdown per unit (engineer)
text: Housing 41 %, shafts and gears 33 %, synchros 11 %, bearings 8 %, labour 7 %. Target reduction 4 % by casting supplier change in Q1.
